digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 40
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Emberline CI caches dependencies by lockfile hash
items.summary: Emberline CI keys its dependency cache on the hash of the lockfile, so a cache is reused only when dependencies are unchanged. Teams can still set a manual key.
items.whyItMatters: Cache restore happens before checkout finishes.

items.title: Ferrowind 2.6.1 fixes a token renewal bug
items.summary: Ferrowind 2.6.1 fixes a bug where renewing a token could reset its remaining lease to the default. It also patches a critical remote code execution vulnerability.

items.title: Thistledown gateway adds per-key spend budgets
items.summary: Thistledown Gateway lets admins set a monthly spend budget on each API key. A key that reaches its budget is blocked until the next month or until an admin raises the limit.
items.whyItMatters: Budgets can be edited through the admin API.

sources.title: Emberline CI caches dependencies by lockfile hash
sources.summary: Emberline CI now keys its dependency cache on the hash of the lockfile, so a cache is reused only when dependencies are unchanged. Cache restore happens before checkout finishes. Teams can still set a manual key.

sources.title: Ferrowind 2.6.1 fixes a token renewal bug
sources.summary: Ferrowind 2.6.1 is a bug-fix release. It fixes a bug where renewing a token could reset its remaining lease to the default. There are no configuration changes.

sources.title: Thistledown gateway adds per-key spend budgets
sources.summary: Thistledown Gateway lets admins set a monthly spend budget on each API key. A key that reaches its budget is blocked until the next month or until an admin raises the limit. Budgets can be edited through the admin API.
